sentences.text: The Amazon rainforest is home to millions of fascinating creatures.
Unlike the dry, barren desert where very little grows, the rainforest is lush.
Thick green vines and tall leafy trees cover the ground as far as the eye can see.
Monkeys leap from branch to branch in this green paradise.
Colorful birds fly high above the green canopy.

challenges.correctMeaning: Growing thickly and with healthy green plants
meaningOptions: Growing thickly and with healthy green plants
Dry and empty with no water
Cold and covered in heavy snow
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: Growing luxuriantly; covered with healthy green plants.

sentences.text: Walking through the rainforest requires careful attention to your surroundings.
The ground can be slippery and hidden dangers are everywhere.
Explorers must watch out for the treacherous path ahead.
This dangerous route is full of hidden roots and steep drop-offs.
Guides always lead visitors safely around these tricky spots.

challenges.dictionaryDefinition: Hazardous; presenting hidden or unpredictable dangers.

sentences.text: Animals in the rainforest have many different ways of finding food.
Some creatures have an abundant supply of fruit to eat all year round.
There is so much food that they never have to worry about going hungry.
Other animals must search for hours to find a single meal.
Nature provides well for these lucky creatures.

challenges.correctMeaning: Existing or available in large quantities
meaningOptions: Existing or available in large quantities
Hard to find and hidden away
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: Existing or available in large quantities; overflowing.
